title: Stepper
description: A task in a few ordered steps (account setup, checkout). Parts: Stepper (bind:value = the current step from 1; horizontal | vertical; linear by default: back to any earlier step, ahead only past done steps; or free), StepperList (default, or the inline bars | dots), StepperItem (value, done (default: before the furthest step reached), disabled, loading, invalid), StepperTrigger, StepperIndicator (a ring, a copper disc when active, a tonal disc with a check when done; a Spinner while loading, a red dot when invalid), StepperTitle, StepperDescription, StepperSeparator (a foreground fill that scales in once the step is done), StepperContent and StepperPrevious / StepperNext (stock Buttons, dimmed but focusable at the ends). In a form, StepperNext checks the current panel's fields first, and a submit with an invalid hidden field goes to its step. Keyboard: the triggers share one tab stop, arrows move, Enter / Space go. Under 30rem only the current title stays in sight.
